claim: The Seconds field of a Wait state is a time in seconds to wait before beginning the Next state, given as an integer from 0 to 99,999,999; in JSONata states it can be a JSONata expression that evaluates to an integer in that range. You must specify exactly one of Seconds, Timestamp, SecondsPath or TimestampPath, and the maximum wait time is one year for Standard Workflows and five minutes for Express workflows.

qualifiers.scope: Seconds field of a Wait state; maximum wait time per workflow type
qualifiers.condition: Standard Workflows: one year maximum wait; Express workflows: five minutes

evidence.quote: A time, in seconds, to wait before beginning the state specified in the `Next` field. You must specify time as an integer value from 0 to 99,999,999. In JSONata states, you can alternatively specify a JSONata expression which must evaluate to an integer in the stated range.

You must specify exactly one of `Seconds`, `Timestamp`, `SecondsPath`, or `TimestampPath`. In addition, the maximum wait time that you can specify for Standard Workflows and Express workflows is one year and five minutes respectively.
